description: Phase 2 all-character battle prototype with dynamically tagged ability catalog, active handlers, reaction windows, timing and movement QA. This is not a full verified D&D rules engine; do not apply simulated state to canonical campaign.
source_priority: state/_campaign-state.json for dynamic current resources, migration cards for reference, rules for policy.
tested_in_browser: Mage Armor action slots deducted and AC increased (12 to 15)
automatic Shield on an eligible 15 vs AC 12 hit: +5 AC and free use
Yar cloak trigger 13 vs AC 11 after optional Protection pass: prevents hit and expends reaction and one charge
movement route from B7 to C7 without disappearing action controls
full Daphne ability catalog visible (31 known entries)
Lyutobor Crusader's Mantle added 10-round concentration effect
Yar Second Wind opens Tactical Shift choice and 15-ft route
initiatives continue through enemy turns and return to Rada
features_implemented_or_prototyped: all known combat abilities listed per character with status labels
attack action and basic extra attacks
after-hit choices: combat maneuvers, smite, shield master, sneak/cunning strike, leaf effects
before-roll Protection, after-hit cloak/uncanny/guardian mark, auto shield
aura saving bonuses and some durations/concentration
pathfinding with manual route and per-cell movement
ability confirmation and AoE target preview
unfinished_or_requires_rules_audit: exact diagonal/grid AOEs, cover and obstacles, vertical movement and flight
multi-beam independent targeting and item focus wave
complicated simultaneous after-hit option stacking (more than one optional feature)
all spell legality, preparation, component and special targeting rules
full monster spellcasting and Counterspell event chain
opportunity-attack path/resume and special movement permissions
accurate per-turn expiration of effects and repeat saves for all conditions
distinct temporary HP, resistances, shield and ring damage ordering for all combinations
DM ruling for unusual actions; no automatic resource expense
